namingRules: Uu tien ten tieng Viet phong cach tien hiep, de doc va de nho.
Co the lay cam hung tu cac nguon da duoc phe duyet khi tao ten moi.
Khong dung ten lam nguoi choi nham la noi dung chinh thuc cua truyen.
Ten moi phai phu hop voi he phai, pham cap, cong nang va cap do vat pham.
Khong doi ten gameplay hien tai neu chua duoc yeu cau ro rang.
